items.title: Trump heads into midterms short on foreign policy wins
items.description: U.S. President Donald Trump's ambitious foreign policy agenda — including the war in Iran — appears stuck as he heads into November's midterm elections.

items.title: U.S. and Iran keep up hostile rhetoric ahead of new sanctions

items.title: Japan eyes fiscal 2027 assumed bond interest rate at 3.8%
items.description: The rate, used to calculate the government's debt-servicing costs, is expected to be raised significantly from 3% in the fiscal 2026 budget.

items.title: U.S. and Canada fail to reach trade pact to avert Trump tariffs
items.description: The lack of a final agreement means that new 50% duties, set to impact some $20 billion of Canadian exports to the United States, took effect Saturday.

items.title: U.S.-sanctioned ICC head warns against ‘demise of international rule of law’
items.description: In her first public comments since the sanctions, International Criminal Court President Tomoko Akane of Japan said she was "not surprised" by the move.

items.title: Japan dad ditches 7-year-old for hours to climb Mount Fuji
items.description: The boy was found alone on a hiking route on Thursday and taken into police custody, a local police officer in Shizuoka Prefecture said Saturday.

items.title: Takaichi takes flak for ‘weak’ responses to U.S. and Russia
items.description: Tokyo did not criticize or lodge a protest against the U.S. sanctions on the ICC president or take measures after the Russian leader's trip to a Japanese-claimed island.

items.title: Japan axes Netflix collaboration after outcry over dating show
items.description: The Justice Ministry axed the tie-up with "Badly In Love," which features ex-juvenile delinquents, following backlash against what some called the glorification of crimes.
